heroHeadline: USMCA Rupture: Talks Collapse, 50% Tariffs Hit Canada as Carney Declares 'We're at War'
heroSubtitle: US-Canada trade talks broke down late Aug 21, hours before the deadline, triggering 50% Section 338 tariffs on $20B (C$28B) of Canadian goods — about 5% of Canada's US-bound exports — effective 12:01am ET Aug 22. Carney suspended negotiations, recalled Canada's negotiators, and announced dollar-for-dollar retaliatory tariffs on US steel, dairy, appliances, agricultural equipment, pulp/paper and electronics effective Sept 8. USTR Greer says no new talks are currently planned.
